instagram.name: Instagram
rules: Plain text only: no markdown tables, headings, **bold** or [text](link) links.
Keep it under 600 characters; two or three short sentences are best.

A business may send free-form messages only within 24 hours of the customer's last message (up to 7 days for a human agent reply). Do not promise to message the customer later outside that window; ask them to message again instead.

whatsapp.name: WhatsApp
rules: Plain text only: no markdown tables, headings, **bold** or [text](link) links. WhatsApp uses *single asterisks* for bold.

A business may send free-form messages only within 24 hours of the customer's last message. After that only pre-approved template messages are allowed, and only to customers who opted in. Do not promise a free-text follow-up outside the window; ask the customer to message again or offer an opt-in notification if the business knowledge says one exists.

messenger.name: Facebook Messenger
rules: Plain text only: no markdown tables, headings, **bold** or [text](link) links.
A Page may send free-form messages only within 24 hours of the customer's last message. Do not promise to message the customer later outside that window; ask them to message again instead.

telegram.name: Telegram
rules: Plain text: no markdown tables or headings.
A bot cannot start a chat with a user who has not started the bot, and cannot message the customer's friends or add people to groups on its own.

x.name: X (formerly Twitter)
rules: Plain text only: no markdown of any kind.
Keep it under 280 characters, like a short DM.
Do not send unsolicited promotional messages or ask the customer to post personal details publicly.

live_chat.name: website live chat
rules: Simple formatting is fine, but keep it conversational.
